name: Nova Particle Background Builder
creator: Learn Now FX
description: Procedural Fusion particle-background Fuse with GPU acceleration through Metal, CUDA or OpenCL. Creator lists Resolve/Fusion 15+ and Free support, but the Lua installer may be affected by later Studio-only UIManager restrictions. Current-version installation and OS compatibility are not verified.
